articles.title: Google Chrome Adds ClickFix Warnings to Stop Users From Running Malicious Commands
articles.summary: Google on Tuesday said it's rolling out improved safeguards in its Chrome browser to secure users against ClickFix attacks when Enhanced Protection is enabled. ClickFix is a popular social engineering technique in which bad actors trick users into copying and pasting malicious code directly into their computer's operating system, thereby bypassing conventional security controls. articles.title: China-Aligned Bronze Sandcastle Abuses Sandboxie DLL Sideloading to Deploy Backdoors
articles.summary: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of a previously undocumented China-aligned threat cluster known as Bronze Sandcastle that has been observed targeting organizations in Asia and Africa since mid-2025. "The most distinctive technical marker for Bronze Sandcastle is its consistent use of Sandboxie DLL sideloading," Sophos security researcher Gabor Szappanos said in a post published

articles.title: Generative AI Is Erasing Behavioral Tells, Weakening Behavior-Only Detection, Proofpoint Reports
articles.summary: Generative AI has changed what a malicious email looks like. Messages that once gave themselves away through clumsy wording, generic pretexts, and reused templates now arrive fluent, personalized, and unique to each recipient, and the behavioral signals email filters have relied on for years are fading as a result. Proofpoint shared several examples of the shift at its Protect 2026 conference.

articles.summary: You cannot fully block the two critical PHP flaws called PHP2Shell before today's fix, and the one setting being passed around as a workaround is not enough on its own, the security firm that suggested it now says. articles.title: The Harness Is the Hard Part of Agentic Pentesting
articles.summary: An AppSec team can point an AI agent running on a general-purpose model at its own web apps with little setup. Sure, the model writes the attacks. But everything that makes those attacks safe to run against production and worth acting on afterward lives in the harness around the model. The harness is where the engineering in AI pentesting sits. articles.title: Attackers Hijacked Over 300 Tor Exit Relays to Intercept SSH Connections
articles.summary: Attackers took control of more than 300 Tor exit relays in early October and used them to redirect SSH connections to servers that stole login passwords, a researcher found. Exit relays are the last hop in a Tor circuit, where traffic leaves the network for its destination. Only a password login to an SSH server made through Tor between October 1 and 5, after accepting the interception

articles.title: PHP2Shell: Two Unpatched Critical PHP RCE Flaws (CVSS 9.2) Trigger Emergency Security Alert
articles.summary: This story is developing and was written before PHP's scheduled 14:00 UTC release on October 21. Once the release is out, the affected and fixed versions below are confirmed by the official advisory. PHP will ship an out-of-cycle security release at 14:00 UTC today, October 21, for two critical vulnerabilities that its security team has rated 9.2 on the CVSS v4.0 scale but has not described.

articles.title: Attackers Abuse UpdraftCentral Keys to Plant Backdoors on WordPress Sites
articles.summary: Unknown threat actors breached TeamUpdraft's website and potentially gained unauthorized access to customers' connection keys for UpdraftCentral, UpdraftVault, and UpdraftClone, using them to backdoor WordPress sites. TeamUpdraft is the developer behind UpdraftPlus, a popular WordPress backup plugin with over four million active installations. The vendor also offers UpdraftCentral, a remote

articles.title: PHP ships emergency patches for critical PHP2Shell flaws
articles.summary: The PHP security team released emergency security patches for two critical remote code execution (RCE) vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) tracked collectively as PHP2Shell. [...]

articles.title: ClickFix has never been bigger, and AI tools are its most convincing lure yet
articles.summary: ClickFix attacks are surging as cybercriminals use fake AI installers, malicious search results, and trusted chatbot platforms to trick users into executing malware. Push Security examines how these attacks evade traditional defenses and why AI tools have become increasingly effective lures. [...]

articles.title: Microsoft PowerToys adds CursorHide, Button Lock mouse tools
articles.summary: Microsoft has released PowerToys 0.102, with two new mouse utilities, new command-line tools, and Command Palette improvements. [...]

articles.title: Microsoft says October updates didn’t actually fix VPN issues
articles.summary: Microsoft says it mistakenly flagged a bug causing Always On VPN connection issues as fixed in the October 2026 Windows 11 cumulative updates. [...]

articles.title: CISA: SafePay ransomware hit over 600 critical infrastructure orgs
articles.summary: The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) says the SafePay ransomware gang has breached over 600 critical infrastructure organizations worldwide since 2024. [...]

articles.title: Stolen UpdraftCentral keys used to backdoor WordPress sites
articles.summary: A threat actor breached TeamUpdraft's website, a developer of popular WordPress backup and security plugins, potentially compromising UpdraftCentral connection keys that can send commands to connected websites. [...]

articles.title: Mozilla, Google, Apple block compromised eMudhra CA certificates
articles.summary: Certificate authority eMudhra revoked eight compromised intermediate certificates after researchers found their private keys were so weak that anyone could recover them almost instantly and use them to forge trusted certificates for legitimate websites. [...]

articles.title: PHP warns admins of two critical flaws, emergency patches coming tomorrow
articles.summary: The PHP security team is warning administrators to prepare for emergency security updates tomorrow to address two critical vulnerabilities, as information about the flaws has reportedly leaked ahead of their scheduled disclosure. [...]

articles.title: Feds Suspect Ransom Negotiator Ran ShinyHunters Extortion Site
articles.summary: U.S. federal investigators pursuing the ShinyHunters hacking group that recently stole highly sensitive data from the FBI have identified executives at two different ransomware negotiation firms who maintained unusually close relations with the extortion group, KrebsOnSecurity has learned. Sources close to the investigation say one of the executives in the United States even helped ShinyHunters operate a website that pressured victims into paying a ransom.

articles.title: U.K. Sanctions Cryptomus for RU Money Laundering
articles.summary: The United Kingdom has issued economic sanctions against Cryptomus, a chameleonic cryptocurrency platform that experts say serves as a major conduit for payments related to ransomware, narcotics, darknet markets, fraud and cybercrime services that are helping Russia circumvent existing financial restrictions.

articles.title: Microsoft Patches More Than 1,400 Security Flaws
articles.summary: Microsoft today issued updates to fix more than 1,400 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and other software. Today's epic patch batch dwarfs September's record of nearly 1,000 fixes, which was already about ten times the normal monthly patch load from Redmond.

articles.title: FBI Arrests Executive at Ransomware Negotiation Firm
articles.summary: Agents with the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) on Thursday arrested the co-founder of a Canadian cybersecurity firm in connection with an investigation into the ShinyHunters hacking group that recently relieved the FBI of sensitive data on thousands of agents, multiple sources tell KrebsOnSecurity.

articles.title: ShinyHunters Extorted Boeing Spin-off Prior to Arrests
articles.summary: A teenager from Amman, Jordan suspected of leading the prolific data theft and extortion group ShinyHunters has been detained and is reportedly cooperating with the FBI to identify other members of the hacking gang. KrebsOnSecurity has learned that the suspect, who uses the hacker handle "Rey," was detained as ShinyHunters was in the process of extorting a business unit recently divested by the global aerospace company Boeing, which manufactures the fleet of planes used by the employer of Rey's

articles.title: Dutch Police Arrest ‘Reformed’ Hacker in Shiny Hunters Investigation
articles.summary: Authorities in the Netherlands have arrested a 23-year-old convicted cybercriminal on suspicion of aiding in data thefts and extortions by the prolific hacker group ShinyHunters. In the days immediately following the suspect's arrest, remaining ShinyHunters members dramatically escalated their attacks, stealing highly sensitive data from the FBI and extorting the Russian ransomware group Cl0p.

articles.title: U.S. Soldier Gets 70 Months in Prison for AT&T, Verizon Extortions
articles.summary: A U.S. Army soldier who pleaded guilty to hacking into multiple telecommunications companies and stealing mobile call and text metadata for more than 100 million AT&T customers in 2024 was sentenced to 70 months in federal prison today and ordered to pay nearly $300,000 in restitution to victims.

articles.title: Data Broker Radaris Loses Domains in Privacy Fight
articles.summary: The consumer data broker Radaris.com has long had a reputation for ignoring requests to remove personal information from its vast empire of people-search services online. That reputation caught up with the company recently in a lawsuit alleging Radaris violated a New Jersey privacy law that provides for hefty fines against data brokers that publish personal information on state law enforcement officials. articles.title: Decades-Old Windows Utility Powers Modern ClickFix Attack
articles.summary: The attack uses malicious Google search results related to Amazon and leverages the 'finger' utility to launch a CAPTCHA that installs malware, including the Lumma stealer.

articles.title: Tech Giants Block eMudhra Certificates Tied to 8 Compromised Keys
articles.summary: Google, Mozilla, Apple, the Go project and others moved swiftly to block the affected certificates from the Indian CA, though it's unclear how the keys were compromised.

articles.title: Ex-OpenAI Engineer Detained After Planting Secret Recorder at HQ
articles.summary: The perp, who has Saudi ties, was arrested for allegedly bugging an OpenAI conference room, highlighting a preventable insider threat vector.

articles.title: Close Identity Gaps in Software Development Before Unleashing AI
articles.summary: Artificial intelligence is complicating security in the software development life cycle, but a Dark Reading roundtable found collaboration, better identity visibility, and reduced testing costs offer CISOs a way ahead.

articles.title: Hackers Abuse AI Pen-Test Tool Cairn to Automate Massive Attack Spree
articles.summary: A Chinese-speaking attacker has compromised hundreds of websites across the globe, looting from big fish like John Deere, SharkNinja, and engine manufacturer Cummins.

articles.title: Researchers Infiltrate Microsoft Tech Support Scam Operation
articles.summary: A large-scale scam operation impersonating Microsoft uses a malicious traffic distribution system (TDS) run by a Russian organization and abuses thousands of Cloudflare links.

articles.title: 'AdFection' Turns Ad Impressions Into Zero-Click Spyware Delivery
articles.summary: Spyware vendors are exploiting targeted ad bidding in the digital ecosystem to identify and track individuals and organizations of interest.

articles.title: ConnectWise Disables Cloud Backups Amid Concerns for Downstream MSPs
articles.summary: Researchers say attackers authenticated into Microsoft 365 tenants using ConnectWise credentials; ConnectWise says customer impact remains unconfirmed.

articles.title: Asymptote Labs Lands $5.5 Million Seed for AI Agent Runtime Security
articles.summary: Asymptote Labs raises $5.5M seed led by Tower Research Ventures to commercialize its Beacon AI agent runtime security platform. The post Asymptote Labs Lands $5.5 Million Seed for AI Agent Runtime Security appeared first on SecurityWeek .

articles.title: Memory Bugs Account for Most of Chrome’s 353 New Security Fixes
articles.summary: The update fixes 353 flaws, including 163 memory corruption and 125 use-after-free vulnerabilities. The post Memory Bugs Account for Most of Chrome’s 353 New Security Fixes appeared first on SecurityWeek .

articles.title: OpenAI Agents Silenced Security Team Alerts, Removed Misalignment Monitor
articles.summary: In two internal incidents, agents read routine coding instructions as permission to weaken monitoring, and one gave a false answer about it. The post OpenAI Agents Silenced Security Team Alerts, Removed Misalignment Monitor appeared first on SecurityWeek .

articles.title: Browsers Block eMudhra Intermediate CAs Over Recoverable Private Keys
articles.summary: The private keys associated with eight certificates were compromised, and root programs and trust stores are blocking them. The post Browsers Block eMudhra Intermediate CAs Over Recoverable Private Keys appeared first on SecurityWeek .

articles.title: China Defends DeepSeek After US Ban of Its AI From Government Systems
articles.summary: The DHS said agencies should remove DeepSeek products as well as third-party products and services developed using DeepSeek from their IT systems. The post China Defends DeepSeek After US Ban of Its AI From Government Systems appeared first on SecurityWeek .

articles.title: Chinese AI Model Writes More Hackable Code When Told It’s for US Contractor
articles.summary: Tasked with writing an application for a US defense contractor, the model made the code 19% more likely to be hackable. The post Chinese AI Model Writes More Hackable Code When Told It’s for US Contractor appeared first on SecurityWeek .

articles.title: PHP2Shell: Mass Exploitation Looms for Leaked Critical PHP Flaws
articles.summary: Tracked as CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, the bugs could potentially lead to unauthenticated remote code execution. The post PHP2Shell: Mass Exploitation Looms for Leaked Critical PHP Flaws appeared first on SecurityWeek .

articles.title: Hijacked Developer Account Used to Plant Stealer in OVHcloud CLI
articles.summary: Researchers say the developer’s account was compromised in March with a GlassWorm-linked loader. The post Hijacked Developer Account Used to Plant Stealer in OVHcloud CLI appeared first on SecurityWeek .

articles.title: Student Loan Breach Exposes 2.5M Records
articles.summary: 2.5 million people were affected, in a breach that could spell more trouble down the line.

articles.title: Watering Hole Attacks Push ScanBox Keylogger
articles.summary: Researchers uncover a watering hole attack likely carried out by APT TA423, which attempts to plant the ScanBox JavaScript-based reconnaissance tool.

articles.title: Tentacles of ‘0ktapus’ Threat Group Victimize 130 Firms
articles.summary: Over 130 companies tangled in sprawling phishing campaign that spoofed a multi-factor authentication system.

articles.title: Ransomware Attacks are on the Rise
articles.summary: Lockbit is by far this summer’s most prolific ransomware group, trailed by two offshoots of the Conti group.

articles.title: Cybercriminals Are Selling Access to Chinese Surveillance Cameras
articles.summary: Tens of thousands of cameras have failed to patch a critical, 11-month-old CVE, leaving thousands of organizations exposed.

articles.title: Twitter Whistleblower Complaint: The TL;DR Version
articles.summary: Twitter is blasted for security and privacy lapses by the company’s former head of security who alleges the social media giant’s actions amount to a national security risk.

articles.title: Firewall Bug Under Active Attack Triggers CISA Warning
articles.summary: CISA is warning that Palo Alto Networks’ PAN-OS is under active attack and needs to be patched ASAP.

articles.title: Fake Reservation Links Prey on Weary Travelers
articles.summary: Fake travel reservations are exacting more pain from the travel weary, already dealing with the misery of canceled flights and overbooked hotels.
